instruction:
Schema: enrollments(student_id, course_id, grade) and courses(id, title)
Join enrollments and courses returning all child rows with parent title
output: SELECT c.*, p.title FROM enrollments c JOIN courses p ON c.course_id = p.id;

instruction:
Schema: enrollments(student_id, course_id, grade) and courses(id, title)
Left join enrollments to courses keeping all enrollments rows
output: SELECT c.*, p.title FROM enrollments c LEFT JOIN courses p ON c.course_id = p.id;

instruction:
Schema: enrollments(student_id, course_id, grade) and courses(id, title)
Right join enrollments to courses keeping all courses rows
output: SELECT c.*, p.title FROM enrollments c RIGHT JOIN courses p ON c.course_id = p.id;

instruction:
Schema: enrollments(student_id, course_id, grade) and courses(id, title)
Count enrollments records per title
output: SELECT p.title, COUNT(c.id) FROM courses p LEFT JOIN enrollments c ON p.id = c.course_id GROUP BY p.title;

instruction:
Schema: enrollments(student_id, course_id, grade) and courses(id, title)
Sum grade per title
output: SELECT p.title, SUM(c.grade) FROM courses p JOIN enrollments c ON p.id = c.course_id GROUP BY p.title;

instruction:
Schema: enrollments(student_id, course_id, grade) and courses(id, title)
courses rows that have no matching enrollments
output: SELECT p.title FROM courses p LEFT JOIN enrollments c ON p.id = c.course_id WHERE c.id IS NULL;

instruction:
Schema: enrollments(student_id, course_id, grade) and courses(id, title)
Full outer join enrollments and courses
output: SELECT * FROM enrollments c FULL OUTER JOIN courses p ON c.course_id = p.id;

instruction:
Schema: enrollments(student_id, course_id, grade) and courses(id, title)
Cross join enrollments and courses
output: SELECT * FROM enrollments CROSS JOIN courses;

instruction:
Schema: enrollments(student_id, course_id, grade) and courses(id, title)
Join and filter enrollments rows where grade > 100
output: SELECT c.*, p.title FROM enrollments c JOIN courses p ON c.course_id = p.id WHERE c.grade > 100;

instruction:
Schema: enrollments(student_id, course_id, grade) and courses(id, title)
Average grade per title for title having more than 3 children
output: SELECT p.title, AVG(c.grade) FROM courses p JOIN enrollments c ON p.id = c.course_id GROUP BY p.title HAVING COUNT(c.id) > 3;

instruction:
Schema: enrollments(student_id, course_id, grade) and courses(id, title)
Max grade per title
output: SELECT p.title, MAX(c.grade) FROM courses p JOIN enrollments c ON p.id = c.course_id GROUP BY p.title;

instruction:
Schema: enrollments(student_id, course_id, grade) and courses(id, title)
Rows joining a city starting with 'N' in title
output: SELECT c.*, p.title FROM enrollments c JOIN courses p ON c.course_id = p.id WHERE p.title LIKE 'N%';

instruction:
Schema: enrollments(student_id, course_id, grade) and courses(id, title)
Join with alias and order by grade desc
output: SELECT c.id, p.title AS detail, c.grade FROM enrollments c JOIN courses p ON c.course_id = p.id ORDER BY c.grade DESC;

instruction:
Schema: enrollments(student_id, course_id, grade) and courses(id, title)
Left join showing nulls for title when unmatched
output: SELECT c.*, p.title FROM enrollments c LEFT JOIN courses p ON c.course_id = p.id;

instruction:
Schema: enrollments(student_id, course_id, grade) and courses(id, title)
Grouped join returning count and sum together
output: SELECT p.title, COUNT(c.id) AS cnt, SUM(COALESCE(c.grade,0)) AS tot FROM courses p LEFT JOIN enrollments c ON p.id = c.course_id GROUP BY p.title;
